analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure that the architecture version ARCH-V21 and the naming conventions for contract owners and container IDs are unified and consistent.
requirements_understanding: The objective is to align contract owners with container IDs.
ARCH-V21 compliance is a key focus.
Name unification is critical for system consistency.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement a verification mechanism for ARCH-V21 compliance.
Ensure naming conventions are consistent across the system.
Develop automated checks for contract and container ID alignment.
clarifications_requested: What specific naming conventions are currently in use?
Are there existing tools for verifying ARCH-V21 compliance?

executive_summary: This project focuses on ensuring ARCH-V21 compliance and unifying naming conventions for contract owners and container IDs.

functional_requirements.title: Verify ARCH-V21 Compliance
functional_requirements.description: Implement a system to verify that all components adhere to ARCH-V21 standards.
acceptance_criteria: All components are scanned for ARCH-V21 compliance.
Non-compliant components are flagged for review.
Compliance reports are generated weekly.

functional_requirements.title: Unify Contract Owner Naming
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all contract owner names follow a unified naming convention.
acceptance_criteria: All contract owner names are audited for consistency.
Inconsistent names are corrected automatically.
A naming convention guide is available to all developers.

functional_requirements.title: Align Container IDs with Contract Owners
functional_requirements.description: Ensure that container IDs match their respective contract owners.
acceptance_criteria: Container IDs are reviewed for alignment with contract owners.
Misaligned IDs trigger an alert for manual correction.
A report of ID alignment is generated monthly.

functional_requirements.title: Automate Name Verification
functional_requirements.description: Develop an automated tool to verify name unification across the system.
acceptance_criteria: The tool scans all relevant components for naming consistency.
Discrepancies are reported to the development team.
The tool runs as part of the CI/CD pipeline.

functional_requirements.title: Provide Compliance Dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Create a dashboard to monitor ARCH-V21 compliance and naming unification status.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time compliance status.
Users can filter by component or module.
Historical compliance data is accessible for analysis.

functional_requirements.title: Document Naming Conventions
functional_requirements.description: Maintain a comprehensive document detailing the naming conventions used.
acceptance_criteria: The document is updated with every change in naming conventions.
It is accessible to all team members.
The document includes examples and guidelines.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance of Verification Tool
non_functional_requirements.description: The verification tool must perform checks within an acceptable time frame.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Checks complete within 5 minutes for 90% of runs.
acceptance_criteria: Verification tool completes checks within 5 minutes for most runs.
Performance is logged and monitored.
Alerts are triggered if performance degrades.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test with simulated data; measure completion time.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Compliance Data
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure that compliance data is securely stored and accessed.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
acceptance_criteria: Compliance data is encrypted using industry standards.
Access to data is logged and monitored.
Unauthorized access attempts are reported.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability of Naming Verification
non_functional_requirements.description: The naming verification tool should scale with system growth.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Tool supports 2x current system size without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: Tool handles increased load without degradation.
Scalability tests are conducted quarterly.
Reports on scalability are reviewed by the team.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Scalability test with double current load.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability of Compliance Dashboard
non_functional_requirements.description: The compliance dashboard should be user-friendly and intuitive.
non_functional_requirements.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 in usability tests.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard is tested with end-users for feedback.
Usability improvements are tracked and implemented.
Regular usability reviews are conducted.

non_functional_requirements.title: Availability of Verification Services
non_functional_requirements.description: Verification services must be available with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Service downtime is logged and analyzed.
Redundancy measures are in place to ensure uptime.
Regular maintenance is scheduled to avoid unexpected downtime.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
